event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Energy-led, megacap-drag, gold-heavy tape.
Oct 13 was a rotation day: XLE +1.80% and XLU +0.58% bid while XLV -1.35% and SOXX -0.17% sagged, with SPY -0.01% flat but IWM -0.43%. ADP weekly +2.475 (prev 2.375) and NFIB 97.9 (prev 98.7) kept inflation worry alive into tomorrow's Sept CPI (fc 0.60% m/m, 3.6% y/y). JNJ -5.73% and C -5.60% on earnings headlines drove the healthcare/financials drag.

INDICES — VIX 15.3, below ma20 15.5, low fear.
SOXX -0.17%, SPY -0.01%, QQQ -0.33%, DIA -0.33%, IWM -0.43%. Small > large by 0.10pp (IJR +0.09% vs SPY -0.01%). Most notable cross-asset: UNG +4.49%, USO +1.36%, TLT +0.41%; GLD -0.13%, UUP -0.38%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 1.3x and IWM 1.1x busy; SPY 0.6x and GLD 0.7x ignored.
SPY vol_ratio 0.6x with price -0.01% = low-conviction drift, no distribution. QQQ vol not flagged but QQQ -0.33% on light tape = soft. Breadth: 53% advancers, %>50DMA 38, %>200DMA 49, up/down vol 1.07, new 60d highs 22 vs lows 29. Participation is weak — narrow, not broad, confirming the flat index mask.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.80%, XLC Comms +0.74%, XLU Utilities +0.58%, XLB Materials +0.57%, XLY Discretionary +0.08%, XLK Technology -0.04%, XLRE Real Estate -0.21%, XLP Staples -0.26%, XLI Industrials -0.28%, XLF Financials -0.42%, XLV Healthcare -1.35%.
Top industries: UNG +4.49%, XOP +2.85%; bottom: DRAM -3.44%, WGMI -3.05%, XBI -3.04%. Flows: XLK +$1500mm (100p) and XLE +$735mm (94p) lead inflows — XLK inflow contradicts its -0.04% price, hinting at accumulation. Money in: Energy, Comms. Money out: Healthcare, Financials. Rotation state: 'broadening participation' at the small-cap edge, but megacap tech and AI hardware fading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.10 = protection bid; QQQ PCR 0.76 = complacent.
QQQ skew +7.8% > SPY +5.5% = tech downside hedged. VIX 15.3 < ma20 15.5 = complacency. VIXEQ 39.8 vs VIX 15.3 = wide dispersion gap, low implied correlation — stock-picker's tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +1.36% (USO) and nat gas +4.49% (UNG) bid despite dollar softness (UUP -0.38%); silver -1.58% (SLV) the outlier weakling vs gold.
Next FOMC Oct 28, 2026. Polymarket: 80% no change, 18% +25bp (5d +3pp), — no hike today.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 56.1, Neutral.
Movers: AMAT -6.69% (WFE share-gain target headline), JNJ -5.73% (dividend PR, but 2.4x vol spike), C -5.60% (2.1x vol spike, earnings beat headline). Momentum: XLK 20d +6.82% best; XLF 20d -3.57% worst. Watch: JNJ (2.4x vol, -5.73%, health drag), C (2.1x vol spike), TAN (5.5x vol, +2.07%, gamma/allocation signal).
